Point No.2: What Order?

8. The above points are answered in the following manner:
Point No.1: In the Affirmative.
Point No.2: As per final order for the following REASONS 9.
POINT NO.1:

It is the specific case of the complainant that the accused have cheated her by getting the sale deed executed by making her to believe that the mortgage deed was being executed as a security for the hand loan.
It is stated that the complainant was in urgent need of money for treatment of her husband.
When she approached the accused they agreed to lend money on security and insisted her to execute mortgage deed.
But they got executed sale deed by taking disadvantage of illiteracy and ignorance.
10. Based on the sworn statements of CW1 to 4, the learned counsel for the complainant urged to take the cognizance and to register Criminal Case for the offences punishable under Section 420 of IPC.
In her sworn statement she reiterated the contents of the complaint.
She has produced the documents at Ex.C.1 to 7.
She also examined CW2 to 4 on her behalf.

By considering the NC: 2025:KHC:51416 HC-KAR facts and circumstances, prima-facie the complainant has made out sufficient grounds to proceed against the accused persons for the offence under Section 420 r/w 34 IPC.
Accordingly, Point No.1 is answered in the Affirmative.

11. POINT NO.2: For the forgoing reasons, the following order is passed;
ORDER Cognizance is taken for the offence punishable under Section 420 R/w Sec.34 of IPC.

In O.S.No.6490/2017, the trial Court based on the pleadings of the parties, has framed the following issues:
"4. On the above said pleadings of the parties, my learned predecessor in office has framed the following issues on 03.11.2018.
1) Whether the plaintiff proves that she is absolute owner of the suit schedule property having right, title and interest as alleged in the plaint?
2) Whether the plaintiff further proves that she has executed mortgage deed on 11.05.2012 but not sale deed?
3) Whether the plaintiff is entitled for declaration that the sale deed registered in the Sub-Registrar of K.R.Puram on 11.05.2012 as null and void?
4) Whether the plaintiff further proves that she lawful possession and enjoyment of the suit schedule property as on the date of filing the suit?
5) Whether the plaintiff further proves that defendant interfered into the peaceful possession and enjoyment of the suit schedule property by the plaintiff as alleged in the plaint?
6) What Decree or Order?
Additional Issues are framed on 01.10.2020.

ORDER "The suit of the plaintiff is hereby dismissed.

Consequently, the plaintiff or anybody claiming through her is permanently restrained from interfering with the peaceful possession and enjoyment of the defendant over the written statement schedule property.
Draw a decree accordingly."

restrained the respondent/complainant from interfering with the peaceful possession and enjoyment of the property by the petitioners herein.
